method.comparison: Same fixed-start scenarios, 1 env, seed42, 1000 steps. Saved YAML adds only world-horizontal roll reward (weight +0.5, std 0.15 rad) aside from log_dir; agent YAML byte-identical. Single training run per variant cannot establish general causal improvement.
method.joint_limits: Foot 10 rad/s, wheel 33 rad/s, hip/thigh/shank 20 rad/s; effort limits taken from telemetry.
method.landing_definition: Peak summed normal force after the longest eight-link unloading interval within reference time 1.1..1.8 s; unloading <=1 N on each measured link.
method.wheel_dx: Absolute wheel link-origin x separation in the base frame; last physics substep aligned to each control sample.
